title: Choose and order at a restaurant
summary: Compare two dishes, choose one, and confirm the order.

learning_chain.title: Choose a Meal and Order at a Restaurant

dialogue_turns.text: You can choose the vegetable pie or the mushroom pasta.
I have a question. What comes with the vegetable pie?
It comes with a small salad.
And what's in the mushroom pasta?
Mushrooms and cream. Would you like anything to drink?
I'd prefer something without cream, so I'll have the vegetable pie and a sparkling water, please.
So that's the vegetable pie with salad and a sparkling water.
